evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: 1973 primary Nb3Ga experiments included partial Ga replacement by Sb, so Nb-Ga-Sb superconducting chemistry is prior art. They do not establish this exact 1a/1b ordering and relaxed Pm-3 chain structure. Dated exact-formula/ordered-phase searches found no matching experimental superconducting source state; the candidate hypothesis is phase/ordering scoped and new to the reviewed catalogue.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The source target path has no signed negative values and Gamma optical compression is positive. Ordered-site entropy, antisite disorder, chain/CDW distortion and Sb SOC are physical competing effects. The target loses to AlNb6Sb at all ten lambda values; that opposite control and its small negative-path risk remain explicit. Different PP paths/code versions across the Rh/Sb comparison are not concealed and the response is not geometry-only causal.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.022252643 eV/A, P=0.051 GPa, full max stress=0.051 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Sb replaces Rh on its unique ordered site. Volume expands 4.3828%, nearest Nb-Nb grows 0.0758951 A and the Nb-to-replaced-site bond grows 0.0531240 A. Direct source lambda rises at all ten sigma values by 17.016–52.766% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.014 to 17.221 K. This coupled chain/site construction is measured, not inferred from an A15 name.
proposed_contribution.next_action: At the frozen ordered Ga/(Rh or Sb) roles compare a common source method and common volume, then test an antisite/disordered or symmetry-breaking chain competitor. Persistent favorable lambda with stable order supports the bounded candidate; loss under the matched method or a lower unstable ordered branch opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
